mapper.select: SELECT audit_hash FROM sys_oper_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_oper_log (user_id, username, module, operation, method, request_params, response_code, cost_ms, ip, oper_time, audit_hash, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{module}, #{operation}, #{method}, #{requestParams}, #{responseCode}, #{costMs}, #{ip}, #{operTime}, #{auditHash}, NOW())
